products.name: DaVinci Resolve AI
products.note: Professional video AI; color grading; facial recognition; local processing option

profile_text.body:
Blackmagic Design is a hardware and software manufacturer serving the feature film, post-production, and broadcast industries. The company describes itself as creating the world's highest quality products for those sectors, with its lineup spanning digital cinema cameras such as the URSA Cine series, live production switchers under the ATEM brand, the Fairlight Live audio mixer, HyperDeck recorders, and a range of network storage, signal conversion, and capture devices built around 100G Ethernet and SMPTE-2110 IP video standards.

The company's primary AI-facing product is DaVinci Resolve AI, a professional video editing and color grading application that incorporates features including facial recognition and offers a local processing option. DaVinci Resolve 21 is among the recent releases noted on the site. The AI capabilities are embedded within a broader software platform that the company positions for high-end post-production workflows.

The held facts on file note no litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations associated with Blackmagic Design at this time.
